description: This file defines functions for resolving transport turn state and WebSocket session policies for OpenAI-related providers, including URL validation, session header generation, and provider URL checks.

methods.name: isOpenAICodexBaseUrl
methods.description: Checks if the given URL matches the OpenAI Codex backend API URL pattern.

methods.name: isAzureOpenAIBaseUrl
methods.description: Checks if the given URL belongs to an Azure OpenAI deployment.

methods.name: normalizeIdentityValue
methods.description: Trims and normalizes a string value, limiting its length.

methods.name: usesKnownNativeOpenAIRoute
methods.description: Determines if a provider and URL combination uses a known native OpenAI route.

methods.name: resolveSessionHeaders
methods.description: Generates session headers if the provider and URL are recognized as a known OpenAI route.

methods.name: resolveOpenAITransportTurnState
methods.description: Resolves the transport turn state including headers and metadata for OpenAI providers.

methods.name: resolveOpenAIWebSocketSessionPolicy
methods.description: Resolves WebSocket session policy including headers and cooldown settings for OpenAI providers.
